visualCharacteristics.structure: wide 13-column data table in a white panel
visualCharacteristics.header: light blue #83b8ec cells, 10px bold text #2d4a6a, left aligned, top aligned, ~50px tall, 2px white vertical gaps between columns
visualCharacteristics.rows: 12px text #333, top aligned, padding 10px 8px 18px, striped: odd rows #e6e6e6, even rows #cacaca, no horizontal gaps
visualCharacteristics.cells: icon cells (:expand:, :alert:, :wrench: icons ~14px) in first two columns; underlined blue (#1f3fbf) 10px links in Disposition
visualCharacteristics.responsive: horizontal scroll wrapper on narrow screens

contentPattern.pattern: service events report: header row + many event rows, 13 columns, icons and links
contentPattern.structure: first row is the header (column names); each following row is one report record with the same number of cells (13 for the service events report). Cells may be empty, contain :icon: names (:expand:, :alert:, :wrench:) or links.
